This matter is taken up by hybrid mode.

2. Heard learned counsel for the parties.

3. The Petitioners have filed this writ petition with the following prayer:
"It is therefore, prayed that this Hon'ble Court may graciously be pleased to hear the matter and after hearing this, admit this writ application and notice be issued to the opposite parties to show cause as to why the adequate compensation and service benefits under the provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 shall not be provided and if they fail to show cause or show insufficient cause issue writ of mandamus to provide adequate compensation and service benefits under the said Act within a stipulated time for the interest of justice.

as in duty bound shall ever pray."

4. In course of hearing, learned counsel appearing for the Petitioners states that the Petitioners have already made representation before the Opposite Party No.2 vide Annexure-3 series, and the same may be directed to be disposed of within a stipulated time, to which learned Counsel for the State have no objection.

without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, disposes of the Writ Petition directing Opposite Party No.2 to consider and dispose of the representation filed by the Petitioners vide Annexure-3 series and pass appropriate order as early as possible within a period of three months from the date of production of certified copy of this order.
